notes.title: 🎮 Popit Game Update — Fixes Loaded, Let’s Play
notes.content:
[p]Smarter, smoother, and more stable gameplay starts today[/p][p]
[/p][p]We’re continuously improving Popit Game to make your play smoother and more fun — and Update 1.0.14 brings several important fixes:[/p][p]
[/p][p]🧩 Changelog Highlights:[/p][p]— Fixed a softlock bug triggered by attacking Popits[/p][p]— Fixed real-time block update issues[/p][p]— Improved font rendering in invoices and screens[/p][p]— Improved spectator mode for better viewing performance[/p][p]
[/p][p]Your feedback is what makes Popit Game better with every patch — keep it coming![/p][p]
[/p][p][i]With love,[/i][/p][p][i]GOSH Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: ⭐️ Popit Game Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[p][u]Here’s what’s new in this version:[/u][/p][p][/p][p]
🃏[b] Deck Screen Fixed[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where the full deck screen didn’t properly update after deck changes  — causing deleted or replaced cards to still appear visually.[/p][p]
[/p][p]🎮 [b]Out of Cards = Game Over[/b][/p][p]From now on, if you discard or delete all your cards and the deck is empty — it’s game over.[/p][p]
[/p][p]👁 [b]Spectator Mode Fixed on Android[/b][/p][p]You can now enjoy watching other players more smoothly.[/p][p]
[/p][p]📱 [b]Scroll Shaking Reduced[/b][/p][p]We’ve fixed scroll behavior to make navigation more comfortable.[/p][p]
[/p][p] 🎯 [b]Popits Display Bug Fixed[/b][/p][p]Popits from the previous opponent’s hand are now displayed correctly when reviewing past rounds — no more confusion during game analysis.[/p][p]
[/p][p]🛠 [b]More Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]Several other bugs and minor issues have also been resolved to make the game run better and smoother.[/p][p]

[/p][p]We listen to every report and suggestion[/p][p]Thank you for helping us make Popit Game better with each update![/p]

notes.title: New Update is Here 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hello! [b]
 
[/b]What’s New? Changelog for the last two versions of Popit Game: 
[b]
Devs made lots of changes.[/b] You've already experienced many of them in-game — [b]but here's a full summary:

[/b]🔧 Popit Changes:[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Removed Entropy Effects from the following Popits:[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p]🎮 Turn the first card to ♠️ in Layout[/p][p]🎮 Turn the first card to ♥️ in Layout[/p][p]🎮 Turn the first card to ♣️ in Layout[/p][p]🎮 Turn the first card to ♦️ in Layout[/p][p]🎮 Convert a card to the left of the last card in Layout into the same last card[/p][p]🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♠️ card in Deck[/p][p]🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♥️ card in Deck[/p][p]🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♣️ card in Deck[/p][p]🎮 Destroy the lowest rank ♦️ card in Deck[/p][p]

[/p][p][b]Following Popits' values have been changed:[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p]🃏 Every scored card permanently gets x value[/p][p]🃏 Permanently upgrade the value of the first card in layout by x. Score next time[/p][p]🃏 Permanently Mult value of the first card in layout by x. Score next time[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Following Popits now add a percentage to the score for each card.[/b][/p][p][b]Also, the chances to get them in the shop are reduced:[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p]🔥 Each card added to Deck adds x% to score[/p][p]🔥 Each destroyed Face card adds x% to score[/p][p]🔥 Popits with Corruption effect give +x Mult each[/p][p]🔥 Each card missing from Deck’s original size adds x% to score[/p][p]🔥 Add 20% of the sell value of all Popits to your Mult[/p][p]

[/p][p][b]Following Popits' chances to appear in the shop were reduced:[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p]🌟 Each scored Ace,2,3,5,8 add x Mult[/p][p]🌟 First Face in Layout card give x Mult[/p][p]🌟 Scored 10 or 4 give +10 Score & +4 Mult Each[/p][p]🌟 Retrigger first scored card (×) times[/p][p]🌟 Scored ♠️ +x Score[/p][p][/p][p][b]

Following Popits' scores have changed, and their chances to appear in the shop were reduced:[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p]⚡️ Each Acki Nacki Popit gives +x Mult[/p][p]⚡️ Scored ♣️ +x Mult[/p][p]⚡️ Earn $ x% of the Credits in your wallet per Block[/p][p]

[/p][p](!) Popit cost has been changed.[/p][p]Previously, each Popit cost 6 Shells.[/p][p]Now, the price depends on the Entropy Effect:[/p][p]6 for a Popit without an Entropy Effect,[/p][p]10 for Aberration,[/p][p]20 for Mutation,[/p][p]34 for Distortion,[/p][p]and 62 for Corruption.[/p][p]

[/p][p]😈 Overdraft Fees calculation has been reworked. Now, under heavy overdraft, Overdraft Fees increase more sharply.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Look around — someone might be planning to attack you right now...

[/p][p]Follow Our Official Telegram Channel for more info: [/p][p][url="https://t.me/ackinackinews"]https://t.me/ackinackinews[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]With love,[/i][/p][p][i]GOSH team[/i][/p]

notes.title: We Have Great News! New Update Is Live ⭐️
notes.content:
[p]Hello! [b]We have a $500,000 prize pool — and[/b] [b]the top 10,000 winners will receive a prize in our Popit Games Tournament! 

And we keep updating the game for your best experience:[/b]


🏆 [b]Leaderboard Updated[/b][/p][p]Yep — it’s now crystal clear who’s winning what.[/p][p]You can instantly see your position and the prize you’re aiming for.[/p][p](We also added some nice music to spice it up)[/p][p]
[/p][p]🔥 [b]Top 50% Now Displayed Accurately[/b][/p][p]No more guessing — you will see whether you’re safe or on the edge, in real time.[/p][p]
[/p][p]👅 [b]Localization Added[/b][/p][p]We’ve added languages for your convenience (and will add more in the future):[/p][p]English 🇬🇧 French 🇫🇷 Catalan 🇪🇸 Portuguese 🇵🇹 Spanish 🇪🇸 Italian 🇮🇹Russian 🇷🇺Ukrainian 🇺🇦Polish 🇵🇱Arabic 🇸🇦Farsi (Persian) 🇮🇷Indonesian 🇮🇩Turkish 🇹🇷Malayalam 🇮🇳Chinese 🇨🇳Japanese 🇯🇵Korean 🇰🇷[/p][p]
[/p][p]🤺 [b]New Attacking Popits[/b][/p][p]You will see more attacking Popits now — and two new ones have joined the tournament:[/p][p]• A Popit that reduces your opponent’s hand[/p][p]• A Popit that shrinks their discards[/p][p]
[/p][p]🎮 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][p]We’ve squashed bugs and smoothed things out for a better experience overall[/p][p]
